images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A top-down city-planning strategy game seen on a dark drafting desk under a warm desk lamp. The left two-thirds is a grayscale aerial survey photograph of a small 16x12 grid city: pale concrete rooftops with AC units and hard SE shadows, dark asphalt streets with faint dashed lane marks, tiny cars, a stippled paved plaza with round tree canopies. Over the photo lies a semi-transparent cream vellum tracing sheet with hand-drawn graphite lines, diagonal hatching for planned buildings and stipple for planned plaza; a stack of slightly offset tracing sheets under the map shows how many days the map was edited. In a small inner courtyard, four cells are under construction with dashed scaffolding, tiny rotating cranes and graphite pressure rings filling up, as the city slowly conforms to the redrawn map. Small glowing red dots mark residents with handwritten pencil names. A worn parcel is marked with an ochre X. Right side: pinned vellum council notes with checkbox goals and a resident list. Bottom: pencil tool buttons and a big 'advance day' button with a 60-day timeline. Palette graphite, photo gray, vellum cream, one accent of brick red. Korean UI text: '지도는 거짓말을 한다', '하루 보내기', '허가비 178원', '안마당 → 광장으로'.

images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same top-down city-planning strategy game at a moment of failure. A grayscale aerial survey photo of a grid city under cream vellum tracing paper, now tinted darker and colder with a heavy vignette and a faint red bloom. In the inner courtyard the city has faithfully built what the map said: three cells are now solid rooftops with dense dark graphite hatching, and two red resident dots pulse beneath the roofs inside red dashed outlines, labeled in pencil as buried. A thin pencil arrow and handwritten note point to the mistake. The tracing-sheet stack under the map is much thicker, 23 sheets. Across the lower map a large hand-lettered cream headline is scrawled at a slight angle, with a smaller brick-red caption on a dark strip below it. Right side: a vellum incident report with a red rubber stamp, harm tallies in red, and two boxed scores comparing 394 versus 260 in red. Bottom timeline bar filled in red to day 38. Palette graphite, charcoal photo gray, vellum, brick red glow. Korean UI text: '지도는 완벽했다.', '사고', '갇힌 사람 2명', '남씨 · 묻힘'. Text constraints: the incident report date reads only "38일째" with no year or month; harm tallies read "갇힘 2명" and "사망 0명" (the buried residents are trapped, not dead); do not show any calendar year or real-world date.
